 Gary Bell
Analysts expect Adverum Biotechnologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADVM) to report $-0.30 EPS on November, 14.They anticipate $0.02 EPS change or 6.25 % from last quarter’s $-0.32 EPS. After having $-0.30 EPS previously, Adverum Biotechnologies, Inc.’s analysts see 0.00 % EPS growth. The stock increased 8.33% or $0.35 during the last trading session, reaching $4.55. About 320,875 shares traded. Adverum Biotechnologies, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADVM) has risen 108.33% uptrending. It has outperformed by 92.71% the S&P500.
Adverum Biotechnologies, Inc., a gene therapy company, discovers and develops novel medicines for patients suffering from rare diseases or diseases of eye. $285.26 million. The firm has a pipeline that includes product candidates to treat wet age-related macular degeneration , alpha 1 antitrypsin deficiency (A1AT), and hereditary angioedema. It currently has negative earnings. The Company’s lead gene therapy programs include ADVM-022 and ADVM-032, which are in the preclinical development of new anti-VEGF gene therapy candidates for wAMD diseases; and ADVM-043, which is in patient enrollment in a phase 1/2 trial for the treatment of A1AT.
